# implicit-sdf.library: ExclusiveOrDistance

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The symmetric difference of two sampled distances: inside exactly one of
> the two shapes. A lower bound — it is built from intersections.
> (IQ: opXor.)

## Signature

```plato
ExclusiveOrDistance(a: Number, b: Number): Number
```
